title: Interactive hero canvas for API onboarding demo screens
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Design an interactive hero canvas and a set of demo screenshots to be used across the API/SDK onboarding docs. The canvas should demonstrate: 1) auth lifecycle (create, rotate, revoke keys), 2) streaming request/response thumbnails with token flow visualization, 3) tool-calling orchestration (tool invocation and structured output), and 4) inline live-code playground thumbnails for quickstart. Assets must be modular (SVG/PNG/MP4) and annotated for docs engineers. Primary goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for developers by showing one-page flows that combine code, network signals, and expected responses.
acceptance_criteria: Hero canvas exported as Figma frames + annotated SVGs for docs team
Three streaming thumbnails (short GIF/MP4) showing chunked streaming and token markers
Key lifecycle visual with 3 states: active, rotated, revoked, and a micro-interaction spec
Tool-calling diagram with structured output example and function signature snippet
All images optimized for web (max 200KB for PNG/SVG, GIFs under 1MB) and accessible (alt text included)
Sign-off from ENG (Arjun Patel) and PM (Samir Gupta) recorded in comments
